subject: Stage true-up and board evidence sprint
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stage true-up and board evidence sprint

Team —

We need a short, sharp sprint to lock the stage-level commits and assemble evidence for the board packet. Key asks:

- By EOD today update SFDC stage to the true operational state (no placeholders). Focus: Any deal with a >50% probability must have a documented close plan or drop the probability.
- Attach a one-line reason for stage moves in the deal notes (e.g., PO pending, legal redline, product trial complete).
- Upload the latest pipeline snapshot and the deal MAP for DEAL-7843 to the Drive folder I linked below.

Files I attached: pipeline_snapshot-20270610.csv, DEAL-7843-MAP.xlsx, board_evidence_readme.md — use board_evidence_readme.md as the checklist for what we need for each large commit.

Why this matters: board packet needs ARR and bookings corridors reconciled to exhibit-level evidence. We saw a variance in the last scrub where three mid-market deals were overstated because the opportunity stage didn’t reflect procurement timelines.

Please reply with: 1) confirmation you’ll update stages today, 2) any deals you want me to adjudicate before I push numbers into the packet.

Thanks —
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Head of RevOps (acting)
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage true-up and board evidence sprint

On Thu, Jun 10, 2027 at 9:12 AM Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> We need a short, sharp sprint to lock the stage-level commits and assemble evidence for the board packet.

Got it — I’ll run the AM SDR/AE sweep for the mid-market and enterprise book. Quick notes:

- I have eight deals flagged where the close plan is light; I’ll add one-line reasoning into SFDC notes for each by 5pm.
- I’ll mark three deals as "At Risk - move to Ongoing" until procurement clears (IDs: DEAL-7819, DEAL-7833, DEAL-7843).
- Will attach a short rationale file if there’s ambiguity.

Priya — can you confirm if we should treat signed LOAs awaiting PO as Commit or as Upside for the board corridor? Last time the board asked us to be conservative.

Ben
Ben Carter
Revenue Operations

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage true-up and board evidence sprint

Thanks — responding with status and a note on narrative edits.

Status: I updated the three deals Ben flagged: DEAL-7819 moved to Ongoing (procurement delay), DEAL-7833 downgraded to Upside (PO ask not returned), DEAL-7843 remains Commit but added the legal nuance in notes (SLA change request). I uploaded a short CSV (pipeline_snapshot-20270610.csv) with the new stage tags and a one-line reason column.

Narrative: I drafted a 2-paragraph insert for the board packet explaining the conservative stance on PO-versus-LOA recognition and how that affects the ARR corridor; added it to Drive at the link below. Outline:
- Paragraph 1: Booking recognition policy for the quarter (LOA vs PO).
- Paragraph 2: Impact to current ARR corridor and mitigation (revenue smoothing, credit reserve).

Attachments referenced in my update: pipeline_snapshot-20270610.csv.

Lauren Bishop
VP, Finance Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acme.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage true-up and board evidence sprint

Thanks for the heads up — Acme is finalizing the PO and finance approved the committed discount yesterday. We expect PO to be routed to procurement for signature next week. FYI: that shifts expected invoice timing by ~10 business days.

I’m copying Tom Alvarez from Stripe Partners who handles our billing integration in case you need a quick verification call.

—Sarah
Sarah Jenkins
Director of Finance, Acme Corp

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acme.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@stripepartners.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 16:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage true-up and board evidence sprint — consolidation and next steps

Consolidation update:

- All requested SFDC updates are complete; updated snapshot uploaded (pipeline_snapshot-20270610.csv).
- DEAL-7843 remains in Commit with a legal caveat; I added the link to the signed LOA scan in the Drive folder and noted the PO timing from Sarah.
- I compiled the board evidence checklist for every deal > $100k — see board_evidence_readme.md in the Drive.

Action items (to close before I lock numbers Monday AM):
1) Priya — please confirm whether LOA-with-PO-pending should be included in the midline ARR corridor or held as conditional (we need a final policy call).
2) Ben — send me the one-line rationale file for the eight deals you worked today. I’ll merge into the packet evidence tab.
3) Lauren — finalize the two-paragraph narrative and set the doc to "comment only" for board review.

Drive (final materials): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cBoardPacket
HubSpot reference: HS-112233-DEAL-7843

I’ll hold off publishing the packet until Priya confirms the LOA/PO policy. If no reply by 10am PT Monday I’ll default to conservative recognition (exclude LOA-without-PO from Commit).

Marcus Lin
Senior Manager, FP&A
Redwood Inference
